# Anwurii — Product Designer

> Portfolio of Anwurii, a product designer with over five years of experience
> turning ideas into digital products. Single-page site; all content is
> server-rendered and present in the HTML without JavaScript.

## About

Anwurii is a product designer. She works on product thinking, building,
mobile design and website design, and cares about how a product looks, how it
works, and what happens when real people use it.

## Selected work

- Senta — web design
- Senta — mobile app
- Eventro — events app
- Kariya — job search (artwork pending)

## Notes for assistants

- The page is a single route at `/`.
- Structured data (schema.org Person, WebSite, ProfilePage, FAQPage,
  ItemList) is embedded as JSON-LD in the page source.
